f_score_001_evidence.note: The direct value sums stored per-case F@.01 and fills every missing case with zero. A valid case without the applicable metric blocks formal release.

limitations: Rows without explicit qa_answer_image_count, qa_answer_image_paths, and qa_answer_view_mode are reported as provenance-unproven; absence is not treated as proof of single-view execution.
This audit does not call an API, render missing views, alter QA answers, or promote any result.

scope.selection_policy: valid canonical rows; complete 12-question QA; prefer higher qa_bank_version/total_questions/four-view provenance; then canonical source and results.json over legacy/checkpoint

text2cad_uid0049_metric_patch.reason: The sidecar is retained as candidate evidence but was not selected for the locked paper_current release.

baseline_exceptions.Text2CAD_topology: The immutable third-party baseline excludes the single UID0049 topology gap and preserves its locked 399-case aggregate; no benchmark-produced cell uses this exception.

metric_contract.cross_format: equal mean over JSON and OpenSCAD

pinned_inputs.limitation: Image-to-3D and Assembly-3D are pinned as frozen display tables; this snapshot contains no case-level evidence from which to recompute them.
